title: Untitled: How sweet a thing is Death,…
text: How sweet a thing is Death, to all who know That all on earth is vanity and woe; Who, taught by sickness, long have ceased to dread The stroke that bears them to this peaceful bed! Few are our days, yet while those days remain, Dur joy must yield to grief, our ease to pain; Then tell me, weary pilgrim! which is best, The toilsome journey-or the traveller's rest??
